Proposition

1. ch6:6.34Let $\{ F_s:N\to M\} _{s\in S}$ be a smooth family with $S$ connected. Then $F_{s_1}$ and $F_{s_2}$ are homotopic for every $s_1,s_2\in S$.

Proof

\sketch A connected smooth manifold is path-connected. For a path $\gamma :[0,1]\to S$ from $s_1$ to $s_2$, the map

\[ H(x,t)=F(x,\gamma (t)) \]

is a homotopy from $F_{s_1}$ to $F_{s_2}$.

□
